description: Electron-based workspace browser for organizing web apps and tabs.

pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Biscuit payload archive was not found: $payload" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mainExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Biscuit payload extraction did not create the expected executable: $mainExe" }

notes: Extracts the Electron app payload from the NSIS installer using Scoop's 7-Zip helper instead of running setup. Biscuit includes its own Electron updater, so it may update files independently of Scoop.
